sensitive-lakeshore-points.geojson.query: where 1=1, geometry = WBD HUC8 07010102 polygon, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects
sensitive-lakeshore-points.geojson.caveats: DNR Sensitive Lakeshore Sensitivity Index (layer 0) -- one point per shoreland analysis window, sum_idx 0-15, rel_score = sum_idx / 23. This service IS the GIS of the 2010 Thompson & Perleberg model output (checked 2026-11-21). `analysis` separates 'Full' (full-survey lakes with individual reports) from 'Abbreviated' (rapid-assessment-model lakes); carry the field so the viewer can label/filter them. 11,289 points is heavy -- needs a display plan (clustering / zoom-gating) before publishing. Loon nesting areas and plant beds are PDF-only and are NOT in this file. Feature count matches the live returnCountOnly count.
sensitive-lakeshore-points.geojson.rel_score_note: CORRECTION to the 2026-11-21 service check, which stated rel_score = sum_idx / 23: that formula does NOT hold in the pulled data (e.g. sum_idx 43 -> rel_score 1.0; sum_idx 4 -> rel_score 0; sum_idx 15 -> 0.44). rel_score is the service's own per-window relative score and is carried exactly as stored; do not recompute it from sum_idx. Full lakes score sum_idx 0-43; Abbreviated lakes 0-9 -- the two products score on different scales, so keep the `analysis` field visible wherever scores are shown.
